name: ShipYard HQ

sources.title: Shipyard HQ — product launch directory and discovery platform (entity/llms.txt page)
Pricing page — listing and promotion plans (referenced)

requirements: Account required: 'A maker creates or signs into a Shipyard HQ account' then submits via the member product submission flow
Product types accepted: apps, SaaS tools, APIs, AI products, developer tools, startup projects
Optional paid visibility plans exist (featured/sponsored/priority/spotlight/analytics placement) but a base listing is part of the standard flow
preparation: Name, tagline, description, logo, website URL
Category, use cases, keywords/tags, supported platforms, product type, pricing model, starting price
The site exposes markdown twins and an API catalog (.well-known/api-catalog) — agents can use structured endpoints
workflow: Create/sign into a Shipyard HQ account
Submit the product through the member submission flow
Fill listing metadata: name, tagline, description, logo, URL, category, use cases, platforms, product type, pricing model
After publication the product gets a canonical /products/<slug> page and appears in /browse, /categories, /tags, /platforms, /pricing, /product-types, /use-cases surfaces
Optionally buy a visibility plan for featured/sponsored/spotlight placement
watchFor: Unusually agent-friendly: site publishes llms.txt, sitemap, API catalog and markdown content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown or /index.md paths)
Paid 'verification'/promotion signals exist — an unverified free listing may rank lower on leaderboards
Votes/visits/analytics drive leaderboard position — a bare listing may get little surface exposure
Site is new/low-DR — treat the listing as a minor citation
countsAsLive: A public product page at shipyardhq.dev/products/<slug> appearing in /browse and category listings
unknowns: Whether the free listing is dofollow
Whether there's a review queue or instant publish
Paid plan pricing specifics (pricing page referenced but amounts not captured)
